documented_probe: C-2035e4ee (implement an asyncio scheduler with a max-concurrency limit): reference floor is hard and this covering task exercises it at hard — gate semantics, ordered results, failure propagation, cancellation of pending jobs, and a measurable peak-concurrency invariant on hidden batches.
notes: Hard because the naive implementations fail: pre-creating tasks violates the gate, unordered completion breaks result ordering, exception propagation must stop pending launches, and cancellation must not let queued jobs run. Hidden cases probe over-subscription, serial limit, mid-batch failure, and cancellation.
